summary_1line: Vidura’s miner secretly digs a tunnel for the Pandavas to escape the lac house, and Bhima later burns the mansion to begin their covert flight.

image_candidates.scene_text: A secret miner kneels inside the lacquer mansion, lifting planks from the floor to reveal a freshly dug subterranean tunnel while the Pandavas watch in dim lamplight.
Bhima ignites the lacquer house at night as fierce wind fans the flames, while the Pandavas and Kunti prepare to slip into the hidden tunnel.
A drunken Nishada woman and her five sons lie asleep inside the mansion moments before the fire spreads through the lacquer walls.
